title: Save is blocked for a bad range end, an empty value and three decimals
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, two ranges ($0.00 to $100.00 and $100.01 and up), Default 40% markup in both.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Change the first range's end to 0.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Change the first range's end back to 100.
  7. Clear Default's first range value.
  8. Click Save.
  9. Type 12.345 in Default's first range.
  10. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The grid is in edit.

Step 4:

  • The first range ends at 0.

Step 5:

  • The save is refused and the range end is highlighted.
  • The message reads "Enter an end above $0.00" or names the start $0.00 the same way.

Step 6:

  • The first range ends at 100 again.

Step 7:

  • The cell is empty.

Step 8:

  • The save is refused, the empty cell is highlighted and the message reads "Enter a value".

Step 9:

  • The cell reads 12.345.

Step 10:

  • The save is refused, the cell is highlighted and the message reads "Use at most two decimals".
  • The grid stays in edit with what was typed.
